name: TimeField
summary: Accepts and edits an ISO local time.

useWhen: Entering a local time of day, such as an opening time
avoidWhen: A date; use DateField or DatePicker
A date and time together, because a time carries no date or time zone

obligations: Expose an editable local time with localized segment names.
Expose disabled, required, and invalid states.

behavior: Controlled and uncontrolled values are supported; a null value keeps a controlled field empty, and clearing emits null.
TimeField works at minute precision: HH:mm:ss values and min/max bounds are accepted with their seconds ignored, and values submit and emit as HH:mm.
A time is a local clock time with no date, time zone, or offset.
The accepted formats are HH:mm, HH:mm:ss, and HH:mm:ss.fraction, and any other string throws a TypeError.
A named TimeField submits HH:mm, or an empty string while it is empty.
Resetting the form restores an uncontrolled field to its default value; a controlled field keeps its value.
Keyboard input preserves the native accessible interaction model.
Min/max time bounds are inclusive; controlled and default out-of-range values remain visible and invalid.
A minValue later than maxValue throws a TypeError, so bounds cannot describe a window that crosses midnight.
Built-in invalid presentation follows the owning Form validationBehavior; name-keyed external errors are exposed immediately.
Interactive control sizes use the shared sm, md, and lg targets; md is the default.
errorMessage renders only while the field is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation, and replaces the built-in message.
accessibility: Expose an editable local time with localized segment names.
Expose disabled, required, and invalid states.
